I answered Tobias in a thread on their #central-random message: the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is on **ticket PD-4821**.

That number comes from a #central-team conversation on Jun 9, 2026, and Tobias is a member of that channel. In it, Hollis said the import file was attached to PD-4821. The file labels the doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02, and that had to be sorted out before anyone reimported or it could create duplicates. I added that to the reply so Tobias has it for the weekly notes.

I found no ticket files for the account in the shared files, so this chat is the only record of the number I could see.
